title: Ubiquiti Unifi U7 Pro Wi-Fi 7 Access Point $295 + Delivery ($0 SA C&C) @ Allneeds Computers
body:
Deal: Ubiquiti Unifi U7 Pro Wi-Fi 7 Access Point $295 + Delivery ($0 SA C&C) @ Allneeds Computers

[omguleh] Not many old units have POE+ on it. Mine is still POE and I’m using U6 pros.
[Gebb] Might be time to upgrade my U6 Lites. Anyone done the same?
[starburstyellow] Not yet. I'm bottlenecked by my UDM atm :(
[frkino] Do you have 6GHz devices?
Also, U6 Lite only needs PoE, is your current power source PoE+ capable? Although, mine is always on 9W through daily use (2.4GHz IoT, 5/6GHz home network)
U7 Pro brings 6GHz radio, and just received firmware update to do MLO
[Gebb] Yes I’m running a USW pro max 16 poe. Only a couple of 6Ghz devices, interested in the 5GHz bandwidth jump and higher gain antennas. If only Amazon would price match
[askbargain] How old is the U6 LR? Power failure yet?
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] I'm not sure, bought it secondhand. Seems to be still working. Separate POE injector.
U6 Pro is running from my UDR v1 POE port ok
[plastic spoon] Has the LR actually improved range at 2.4GHz?
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] I think so? I realised I had far too many APs so reduced them down.
[Ragnarok1983] Need an Unifi controller. You can host your own
[plastic spoon] Yep, works with everything. You will need the unifi controller software to set it up but not for ongoing use.
[Horacio] That's a cracking price. I am thinking I'll pass on 6GHz and get a TP-Link Omada EAP723 but this would be nice if money wasn't tight
[internet-stranger] Check out the EnGenius ECW512L.
On Amazon for $170 + 15% off.
I moved to these. I can get 980mbs on Speedtest.net on my iPhone 16 Pro.
Free cloud management, 6ghz support, 2.5gbe ports.
https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0DNNVJLPP
[bri11iant-y] This looks like a very very powerful AP, tempted
[internet-stranger] For the price it’s amazing.
I can max out my 1gbe NBN over wifi.
My iPhone 16 pro gets 1.4gbe using iperf3.
[Horacio] Thanks and thanks for the other posting on this. Not sure who is negging, it seems so pointless when people are trying to be helpful
[OzComment] if you don’t need 6Ghz you can consider U7 Lite. One of the most affordable but capable APs from Ubiquiti.
[PantlessBobby] Out of stock? Can't add to cart. Devistated.
[cytotoxic] Worth the extra for the 7 Pro XG for the fanless design?
[OzComment] If you plan to use the AP for a few years then yes. If you will chase for wifi 8 when it's available then no
[Akor3] It says in stock but won't let you add the cart anymore..
